items.text: Scenario selection: Crater, Frozen Grove, Dreadnought playable. Others listed as *unavailable* (not in supplied Scenario Book pages). Auto
Society card I–VI × Normal/Hard (+Survivalist extra) gives: Citizens [W,E,C], sick [W,E,C], Automatons, Discontent X/Y, Hope X/Y, Corpse start, Food, Wood, Coal, Steam Cores. Auto
Generator tile in centre: Cookhouse on the top space, 5 Wood on UL, 5 Coal on UR, Generator & Platform printed on LR/LL (5 spaces; drawer hex is NOT a space).

Rim: 7 Starting Wall tokens (3 blank, 2 Wood, 2 Coal) shuffled; from a chosen corner go clockwise placing tokens until 3 Deposits are placed; corners without a Deposit get a Far tile (face up) and a Near tile between it and the Generator tile. Auto (random start corner)
Revealed setup tiles: place Trees/Resources from the bank; Food bonuses are added to starting Food.
Hope/Discontent bags (9 tokens each). Draw X, first Y active (leftmost), rest exhausted.

Round marker 1; Morning deck shuffled (M001–M032 base game, 32 cards; M033–M040 added with the extra pack); Storm marker on 9 (Crater, stormCard S08). Auto *(closure: done. setup.ts createGame ~85-223; tests/audit7_setup-dawn-morning.test.ts 'SET-08'; text corrected to M001–M032 as the engine and rulebook use.)*
Future Law display: L01–L08 + 4 random of L09–L16 (+extra pack L17–L20 optional); Law Consequence cards face down; law-specific buildings made available.
Generator board: Heat marker (normal side) on 1, Cold on 5, Red/Orange/Yellow indicators on Generator track 1/2/3; Weather deck W01–W13 shuffled.
Dusk board: D000 "The Inevitable" + top Social Dispute card shuffled (face down) form the Dusk deck; other Social Disputes stay in their pile (reading it = shown to players once).

Advisors: each player chooses 1 (random if disagreement); solo also takes Call to Rise. Choice made in the lobby (ADP-07); in-game ask not implemented. *(closure: DECLARED adaptation ADP-07: advisors are chosen in the lobby; the in-game per-player choice and seat order are not implemented.)*
Citizen deck shuffled; hand sizes: solo 7, 2p 6, 3p 5, 4p 4.

Each player discards one Citizen card paying its starting cost (cannot pick a card whose cost can't be paid; if none payable: discard any, add 1 sick Citizen of the card's type). Ask *(closure: done. setup.ts:239-285; tests/audit7_setup-dawn-morning.test.ts 'SET-14'.)*
Expedition decks A/B/C (white side up); 3 A cards start the 3 stacks. *(closure: done. setup.ts expeditions block; decks.expA holds only A cards; 'SET-15' test for crater, frozenGrove, dreadnought.)*

Technology display: 4 random (T09 only in Frozen Grove, always shown there), each with an *inactive* Development token. *(closure: done. setup.ts techs ~177-185; T09 only in frozenGrove; 'SET-16' test seeds 1-8, three scenarios.)*

Scenario cards: S01 face up, Scenario Trigger tokens on Round 4 and 11, Storm card S08 (S09 Frozen Grove) set aside face down. *(closure: done. Crater scenarioDisplay S01, triggers rounds 4 and 11, stormCard S08; Frozen Grove stormCard S09; 'SET-17' test.)*
Leadership marker to a random player; game starts in the Action Phase of Round 1 (phases 1-5 are skipped in Round 1).
Hunger marker 0; Stress track empty; Heat marker normal side; no Laws. *(closure: done. newGameState: hunger 0, stress 0, overflow 0, broken false, heat 1, laws []; 'SET-19' test.)*
Pass Leadership clockwise (solo: no change). Auto
Round marker +1.

If the Round marker reaches the Development token: flip it active on the Technology card that has no token; Ask which inactive Technology to develop next (token placed `cost` spaces ahead, max 15). Tech is active for the rest of the game.
Scenario Trigger token on the Round marker's space: remove the token and resolve its Scenario card section (S01 Round 4 / Round 11, S04 Round 12 replaces the whole Round).

Dawn-phase text on face-up Scenario cards (S06 Vox Populi). *(closure: done. fireDawnTriggers (scenario.ts ~178-200) applies Discontent +1 each Dawn while S06 is face up; a repeated Dawn Discontent is a player choice, as the card text says; tests audit7_setup-dawn-morning.test.ts 'DAW-05'.)*
Storm marker on the Round marker's space is resolved in the Weather phase, not here. *(closure: done. phDawn leaves the Storm to phWxStorm (phases.ts ~203-206); 'DAW-06' test.)*
Reveal top Morning card; resolve instant effect (`top`). Auto *(closure: done. cards.ts morningDraw ~89-94, cardResolve ~105-130; tests audit7 'MOR-01' and audit5_cards_morning.test.ts.)*
If options exist: Ask the group (Leadership decides) to pick an option; options with a red prerequisite (`req`) are only selectable when it holds. Cards with a `branch` auto-select the option.

After resolution: card is removed (back in the box; Resources on it → bank, Meeples on it → supply) or placed in the Event display. *(closure: done. Meeples return to the supply (cards.ts removeEventCard ~41-52). Resources on a removed card go to the bank, which is the stock outside the city supply, so they leave play and s.res is unchanged; tests/audit7_setup-dawn-morning.test.ts asserts both.)*

Adds the named Dusk card (`dusk:Dxxx`) to the Dusk deck unseen and shuffles. *(closure: done. M003 option 0 adds D005 to decks.dusk (not the display) and M003 is removed; 'MOR-04' test; audit_2_custom_fx.test.ts.)*

Event display: cards with an Action Phase special action (M004, M010, M015, M029, M038, D037, D043, D062), Dusk/Night phase text (D003, D008-D011, D022, D023, D037, D062), passive effects (M022, D062, D064). *(closure: fixed. D062 passive noEngineerSpecific is now enforced: engineerSpecificBarred in laws.ts, checked in buildings.ts usageProblem (Engineer-only buildings) and actions.ts (other cards' Engineer event actions). normalAllowed was deliberately not changed. Tests: audit7_fix_mor05.test.ts. Open detail: the T15 Hothouse Engineer bonus is not treated as Engineer-specific.)*
Morning deck empty → nothing is revealed. *(closure: done. cards.ts morningDraw ~89-94: no card, no decision, no log; 'MOR-06' test.)*
Optional fuel at the start: spend any Coal (supply→bank); Heat marker +1 per Coal; may reach the Cold marker but not beyond. Ask

Cold sickness: for each citizen icon on Heat-track spaces strictly between the Heat and Cold markers, +1 sick of that type (overflow flips the marker). (Start: Heat 1, Cold 5 ⇒ spaces 2,3,4 = Child+Worker+Engineer.)

Stress check: cubes dropped = value of the Heat marker's space ([2,2,3,3,4,4,4,5,5,6,6,7,7,8,8,9]). Digital tower: each cube independently lands in the drawer with p=0.55 (0.40 once the Generator Upgrade piece is placed); cubes land on the 10 Stress slots then the overflow. (House approximation of the physical tower.)
T06 Generator Safety: before the breakdown check, ≤2 cubes in overflow are removed without effect.
Overflow > 0 ⇒ breakdown. First: flip Heat marker overheated, Cold +1 & all three Heat Range indicators +1, return all Stress cubes. Second (already overheated): the Generator explodes → LOSE.
Heat marker returns to space 1 after the check (also after a breakdown).
Steam Hub coal (Frozen Grove) returns to the bank at the end of the Generator phase. *(Stress step returns it; tests/audit5_scenario_steamhub.test.ts)*

Cubes that fall out while *inserting* the drawer carry over to next round: each cube in the drawer after the drop falls out again with p=`pDeferred` (0.25, a design choice; the rulebook prints no value); the carry (`s.gen.carry`) is placed on the Stress track at the start of the next Generator Stress step. *(closure: fixed (audit7 fix pass). generator.ts genStress; the existing s.gen.carry field is reused; older saves load with 0; tests/audit7_fix_gen08.test.ts, 5 tests. The web HUD does not show the carried cubes.)*

Reveal & discard top Weather card. If the Weather deck is empty, the Weather discard pile is reshuffled into a new deck and the top card is revealed (engine: `phases.ts` `drawFrom`; the rulebook is silent on an empty deck); with both piles empty there is no effect. Unreachable in play: the deck holds 13 cards and every scenario ends by victory at S04 (Round 12), so at most 11 Weather Phases occur (`scenario.ts` `checkEnd` / S04 trigger). Tests: `audit_8_rules_checklist_docs.test.ts`. *(closure: DECLARED: reshuffle of an empty Weather deck is an interpretation (rulebook silent) and unreachable in the three playable scenarios.)*
(A) Advance Cold marker and Yellow/Orange/Red indicators by the card values, clamped to 16.
(B) Gain `hunt` Food per Hunting symbol (Hunter's Hut 1, upgraded 2; D064 event adds 1); T02 +1 Food per 2 symbols; T14 +1 Food per Map tile with a Food bonus.
(C) Advance every Scout by `scout` spaces (see EXP-xx).

(D) Storm marker moves back `storm` spaces; if on/before the Round marker a Storm hits: reveal the scenario Storm card (S08/S09). Crater: Round ≤7 flip all Tents to Ruins and Storm marker → 12; Round ≥8 flip Bunkhouses and remove the marker. Card text beats rulebook wording.

L16B (Survival of the Fittest) weather effect while covering its Law. *(closure: done. law_consequences.json L16B weather: each active Greed hunger+2, then coverToDiscard; laws.ts coverRuns; tech.ts weatherFxRuns; phases.ts phWxFx; test in audit7_gen-weather-prep-dusk-hunger-night.test.ts. The coverToDiscard handler (fx/tokens_cards.ts:75) is not asserted there.)*

Ask which Advisor (if any) is used this Round (Leadership has the final word; one per Round, same one may repeat). Use = exhaust the stated Hope (Generator: any Hope; Health: Care; Social: Justice; Foreman: Motivation).

Advisor effects: Generator remove ≤3 Stress; Health Cure 2; Social reveal 3 Dusk cards, may discard 1 (not a red-icon Social Dispute) w/o effect, shuffle other 2 back; Foreman place a tile as Remove Snow (Near else Far).

Solo: Call to Rise (once, independent of the Advisor, then removed): draw 1/2/3/4 Citizen cards if ≥1/2/4/6 Hope tokens. *(closure: done. phases.ts callToRiseRow (advisors.json callToRise.table) and phCallToRise (247-284): solo only, once, optional play or keep. No dedicated test found in this pass.)*
Check lose: ANY single Sickness marker on space ≥26 ⇒ LOSE.
Resolve each Sickness marker lowest→highest by band: 5-9 flip 1 · 10-14 spent 1 + flip 1 · 15-19 spent 2 + flip 2 · 20-25 spent 3 + flip 3 · 0-4 nothing.

Spent Citizen tokens of the matching type are placed in the supply; flips follow FLIP rules (SIC-xx). *(closure: done. sickness.ts addSpent (capped at 5 per type, 15 total) and sicknessResolve (183-203); tests in audit7_gen-weather-prep-dusk-hunger-night.test.ts.)*

Start: adjust supply Meeples to the Citizen thresholds (Scouts count as in supply); place a supply Meeple of the matching type on each Spent Citizen token (those Meeples cannot act; if not enough Meeples the token stays empty). *(closure: done. actions.ts:402-432; audit7_action-a.test.ts ACT-01 (two tests). Scout-counting path not directly tested.)*
Turn order: Leadership holder first, clockwise, until Meeples run out or all players pass in a row. Ask (current player).

Free before an action: Fuel the Generator (no stress check). *(closure: done. Once per turn (rulebook p23): actions.ts:382, 473-478, flag cleared in actEnd and on pass; regressions.test.ts. The ENGINE_SPEC once-per-phase wording was the stale part.)*

Main actions with one available Meeple: Remove Snow, Gather Resources, Construct, Use a Building, Deploy Scouts, Special Action. *(closure: done. actions.ts:174-191, 258-277, 334-341, 375-391; actions.test.ts:70-92; audit7_action-a.test.ts ACT-04.)*

Child Meeples cannot take actions unless a Law/effect allows (L01 Child Labour: Gather + Gathering Post up to 3; T16 Cookhouse; M022 forbids). *(closure: done. normalAllowed and usageProblem; M022 path at actions.ts:179 and 230 (morning_2.json). The M022 path is code-read only, with no direct test. Child Worker/Engineer act as adult role via roleOf (util.ts:39-48).)*

Automaton acts as a Worker for 1 Coal per use; cannot go on Expeditions or fill Event cards that require a Worker/Engineer; T17 any building / free when Heat above Red. *(closure: done. actions.ts:78-82 (1 Coal; free with T17 above Red), 189 (no Deploy), 297-314 (no Event cards needing Worker/Engineer). The Event-card exclusion (eventDisabled) has no direct test.)*

Heated vs cold: Construct, Deploy Scouts, Special Actions always heated; Remove Snow always cold (T11: always heated); Gather and Use a Building heated iff Heat marker level is strictly above the matching indicator for the *tile zone* OR the *building insulation*. Heat marker on space 1 ⇒ all cold.
Cold action: before resolving, +1 sick Citizen of the acting Meeple's type (Automatons: none).
Zones: Red/A = Generator tile; Orange/B = Generator tile + adjacent tiles; Yellow/C = within 2 hexes. Insulation: R→Red indicator, O→Orange, Y→Yellow, B→zone only, W→irrelevant.

Field Kitchen: actions/buildings on its tile (and shelter at Night) count as heated. Steam Hub (Frozen Grove): holds 1 Coal ⇒ its tile and adjacent tiles heated. *(closure: done. map.ts:181-212 (tileForcedHeated, spaceHeated, buildingHeated); actions.ts:128-137; audit_1 test (Heat 1); audit7 Field Kitchen shelter tests; audit5_scenario_steamhub.test.ts.)*

Frozen Grove: actions allowed only on tiles adjacent/connected to the Generator tile. *(closure: fixed. spaceAllowed moved to map.ts (re-exported from actions.ts) and applied in buildings.ts placementOptions (Small and Large) and usageProblem ("Not connected to the Generator"). Heating and Dismantle/Destroy untouched. Tests: audit7_fix_act11.test.ts (6 tests); it.fails flipped to it in audit7_action-a.test.ts and audit7_scn-lose-players-digital.test.ts.)*
Choose: two Near tiles (not necessarily adjacent) OR one Far tile (only one if one slot left). Repeatable.
Near tile adjacent to the Generator tile; Far tile adjacent to a tile connected to the Generator tile but never adjacent to the Generator tile.
Tiles drawn face down, then flipped; place Trees/Resources from the bank; gain Food bonus.

Citizen-card variants (C08, C09, C13, C21, C22, C26) and Foreman/E tile effects. *(closure: Citizen variants C08, C09, C13, C21, C22, C26 and the Foreman advisor checked against the images and tested (tests/audit8_group_rs4.test.ts). Still open: the "E tile effect" named by this item is not identifiable in the data or rulebook; C26 reorder outcome only checked as a prompt.)*
Place Meeple on an unoccupied space with Coal/Wood/Steam Core; take up to 2 Resources from that space (T07: up to 3 from any spaces on that tile). Each space once per Round. Repeatable.
T04 Chainsaw / C04 Paolo: unoccupied space with Trees: remove 1 Tree, gain 2 Wood.
Space limit: ≤5 Resources of one type, ≤1 Building per space. Generator tile has 5 spaces.

Meeple on the Construction space; up to 3 sub-actions (Build/Dismantle) in any order (T08: 4). *(closure: done. Budget: buildings.ts:494-514 and startConstruct 471; C10 Upgrade costs 2 (tokens_action.ts:133-138); C06 move (tokens_action.ts:100-127) code-verified, no test. Tests: audit5_actions_spend_construct_gather.test.ts; audit5_repair_construct_gather.test.ts.)*

Build: pay Wood/Steam Cores (column cost) or law/event cost; building goes on a space without Meeple or Building; Resources/Trees there return to the bank; Large = both spaces of one tile; red Build icon (Ruins) cannot be built; Coal Mine/Wall Drill only on a tile adjacent to a Rim Deposit of that type; Field Kitchen not on the Generator tile; supply of pieces limited (see `limits`).

Dismantle: building with no Meeple returns to the Buildings board; a red Dismantle icon cannot (modelled as the printed starting pieces plus the Beacon; icon set not yet confirmed against the art); Ruins removed from the game; T08 +1 Wood. *(closure: Red Dismantle icon checked on the tile images: Cookhouse, Beacon, Snow Pit (field_kitchen_back); Snow Pit now has noDismantle. tests/audit8_group_actco3.test.ts.)*

Dreadnought: Steel substitutes for Wood (mixing allowed); paying the full Wood cost in Steel upgrades the new building free. *(closure: done. buildings.ts:83-90 (costPayable), 655-691 (bldPay, fullSteel upgrade), 769 (upgrades Wood-only); audit7_action-b.test.ts 'ACT-CO4' (3 cases).)*

First Workshop built ⇒ Ask which Technology to start; its Development token goes `cost` spaces ahead of the Round marker (max 15). Further Workshops don't add tokens. If all Workshops are gone the token returns (progress lost). *(Wave 6: the hook used the nonexistent op `techStart`; now `techStartCheck`, buildings.ts; tests/audit6_tech_start.test.ts)*

Engineer-only buildings: Workshop, Platform, Generator, Factory, Medical Post, Infirmary, Temple, Propaganda Centre. *(closure: done. buildings.ts:372-379 (L18 Worker exception for Workshop and Generator; T17 Automaton); roleOf maps child engineers and workers; audit7_action-b.test.ts 'ACT-UB1'.)*

Cookhouse: spend 3 Food → +1 Hope or −1 Discontent. *(closure: done. buildings.json cost pay:food:3; bldUse buildings.ts:1031-1054; audit7 'ACT-UB2'. The two option contents are checked by count only.)*
Platform: introduce a Law (LAW-xx). *(closure: done. buildings.json action custom:introduceLaw; fx/tokens_law.ts:69 → laws.introduceLaw. The Platform path was not tested end to end.)*

Generator: remove ≤5 Stress cubes, or spend 1 Steam Core to remove all (first Core spent places the Generator Upgrade piece); T06 removes 1 more. *(closure: done. buildings.ts:329; fx/tokens_build.ts:81-85 (generatorUpgradeOnFirstCore); audit7 'ACT-UB4 / ACT-UB3'.)*

Workshop: two effects (may repeat): upgrade a building (cost from board; not with a Meeple on it) or move the Development token back 1 (develops immediately on reaching the Round marker). *(closure: done. Repeats allowed per rulebook p42; canUpgrade buildings.ts:244-249; laws.test.ts:118.)*

Charcoal Kiln (1 Wood→4 Coal / upg. 5; T03 Tree instead of Wood), Hunter's Hut (gain 4/5 Food), Gathering Post (take 1 Resource from each adjacent space), Factory (1 Core → Automaton), Sawmill (remove 1 Tree on the same tile (upg. also adjacent) → 3 Wood; T10 +1), Medical Post (Cure 3 / upg. Cure 4 or Treat 1; T05 Treat 2). *(closure: done. buildings.json matches the appendix; buildings.ts:319-328; coverage_tech.test.ts. Factory has no direct test.)*

Beacon: passive 1/2 Expeditions. Coal Thumper: 3 Coal on each of 3 (upg. 4) different adjacent spaces that hold Coal or are empty of Resources/Trees/Buildings (≤5 Coal per space; T13 +2 Coal). Infirmary: Cure 4 or Treat 2 (upg. 5/3). Hothouse: 7/9 Food (T15). Coal Mine 4/5 Coal; Wall Drill 3 Wood. *(closure: done. buildings.ts ~897-959 (Coal Thumper from the bank, 5-per-space cap); audit_1 'Coal Thumper places Coal independent of the bank stock'; values checked against pp43-44.)*

Law buildings: Child Shelter, Care House (Cure 2, or Cure 5 exhausting an active Care), Fighting Arena (−1 Disc), Public House (+1 Hope), Field Kitchen, Cemetery (corpse back 1-2 then +Hope), Temple (activate all Hope of one type), Faith Keepers (draw 3 Dusk, discard 1), Snow Pit (on build: corpse back 1-3), Propaganda Centre (reuse an occupied building, heated), Agitator (exhaust all active Discontent of one type), Prison (Hunger −4, Meeple sleeps there). *(closure: Temple, Agitator, Faith Keepers, Propaganda Centre tested (tests/audit8_group_ub8.test.ts); fixed Propaganda Centre offering itself for reuse (infinite loop). Reading note: engine allows any occupied building, rulebook says Citizen Meeple.)*

Dreadnought tile: Small Building, Blue insulation; Meeple placed there gains 1 Steel. *(closure: done. buildings.json dreadnoughtTile (gain:steel:1, count 4); util.ts:120-124; tiles.ts:306; audit7 'ACT-UB9'.)*

Upgrading flips the building; upgraded cannot upgrade further; diamond-marked buildings cannot be upgraded. *(closure: done. canUpgrade and upgradeCostOf buildings.ts:93-102, 244-249; buildings.test.ts:95-99.)*
Beacon required. A Worker/Engineer Meeple becomes a Scout on the first space of an unoccupied Expedition stack. Max active Expeditions: 1 (2 upgraded Beacon). T01 +1 space when deploying/continuing.

Citizen-card variants C03/C07 (bonus resources under the stack), C05 (replace stack with a B card). *(closure: done. citizens.json deployScouts / expeditionBonus; expedition.ts:131-160 (C05 offered only when the replacement can happen); audit7_action-b.test.ts 'ACT-DS2'.)*

Scenario/Event card special actions; once per Round (some once per game); heated unless noted; Meeples on them are removed at Night, Resources on the card stay. *(closure: Night removal of Meeples from special-action cards, usedEver and once-per-Round tested through the real ops (tests/audit8_group_sp1.test.ts).)*

Stockpile (S03 3 slots / S07 6 slots): spend Food/Coal → Food Ration (3 Food) / Coal Stock (2 Coal) markers, total ≤ slots; Worker/Engineer only. *(closure: done. scenario.ts:382-440 (stockpileAction, scnStock, scnStockPick); scenarios.json S03/S07; scenario.test.ts 'Stockpile (ACT-SP2, custom:stockpile)' and menu tests.)*

Using a Meeple of the card's type on the card's action (and building where relevant) may play that card instead of the normal effect; one card per action, one per player per Round; card then goes to the discard pile. *(closure: done. playableCards blocks a second card per player per Round (actions.ts:229), card recorded at 565, playedCitizen cleared at each Round start (phases.ts:138). C20 and C23 cost gating in citizenCostProblem. Discard path actions.ts:845-847 read in the closure pass, not re-tested.)*
Death effects (columns per dead type) used when a Citizen dies (DEA-03). *(closure: done. sickness.ts:124-173 (deathCard, deathCard2, deathCard3); citizens.json death map.)*

Resolve all "DUSK PHASE:" text on Scenario & Event-display cards first (any order). Ask order if >1. *(closure: done. phases.ts duskRuns / duskPick (295-318): Leadership holder is asked when more than one item is pending; a single item runs without a question.)*

Shuffle the Dusk deck, reveal the top card; instant effect; options (Ask with `req`); `branch` cards auto-select. *(closure: D012, D030, D053, D073 compared with the card images; behavioural tests in tests/audit8_group_cards_dusk.test.ts.)*

Card fate: removed / Event display / Dusk discard pile (default for cards without an icon). Red-icon cards (Social Disputes, some Law consequence) never go to the discard pile. *(closure: partial. The fix pass found the claimed gap not reachable with shipped data: the red X is on 12 of 40 Law consequence cards and on 38 of 39 Dusk cards, so it is not a clear "never discard" marker (meaning unconfirmed); every red-X Law card sets an explicit fate; no Dusk card uses the discard token. No code change.)*
Social Dispute: after resolving remove it, take the next Social Dispute card and shuffle it with the Dusk deck AND discard pile into a new deck (none left → no new one).

Dusk deck empty (and discard pile) → no card. *(closure: done. cards.ts drawDusk (84-101) reshuffles the discard into an empty deck and returns null when both piles are empty; rulebook p27 supports the reshuffle reading; audit7 tests.)*

Social Dispute behaviours (SD01-SD10) per `social_dispute.json` (most-common-token, hope vs discontent, no active discontent, all hope types). *(closure: done. social_dispute.json SD01-SD10 checked line by line against the card images (sheet 545_0); cards.ts socialResolve 270-330. Runtime helpers (takeMapRes coal fallback, buildFree:maxWood2) not individually traced.)*
Spend Food to reduce Hunger as far as possible (1 Food = −1 Hunger). Auto, with L03 Food Additives optional at the start.

After spending: Hunger ≥25 ⇒ LOSE; 1-24 ⇒ apply table: 1-4 +1 Disc · 5-9 +1 Disc, 1 dies · 10-14 +1, 2 die · 15-19 +1, 3 die · 20-24 +1, 4 die. Deaths are of the type of the previous Round's column (Round 1: current Round). Hunger then resets to 0.

Feed: 1 Food per Citizen of the type of the current Round column (round r → (r−1)%3: 0 Child, 1 Engineer, 2 Worker). Each missing Food = +1 Hunger. L16 Starvation Rations: cost reduced by number of Meeples of that type.

Hunger reaching ≥25 here flips the marker to the 25+ side and restarts at 0; the loss is checked next Hunger phase (so effectively next phase's start value is ≥25 + carry). *(closure: DECLARED reading: rulebook says "flip the marker to the 25+ side and place it back at the start of the track"; the engine keeps the excess over 25 (flipped marker at position = excess), so the loss is checked next Hunger phase. The text does not state the excess explicitly.)*

Food max 50, Hunger max 50. *(closure: done. util.ts LIMITS; util.ts gainRes; fx/tokens_people.ts (Food cap 50); tokens_supply.ts Hunger clamp 0..50; invariants.ts; audit7 'gaining Food stops at 50'.)*
Return Spent tokens that hold Meeples (Meeples back to supply); tokens without Meeples stay.
Return all Meeples placed this Round (map, supply board, Event cards) except Scouts.
Optional fuel (Generator).

Count sleeping slots in heated shelters (Tent/Bunkhouse/House 2 each; Ruins 0 unless L06; Child Shelter 4 Children; L05 +1 per heated shelter; T12 heated Medical Post/Infirmary 1 Engineer; Prison). Ask which Meeples sleep.
Every Meeple still standing (not Scouts, not Automatons): +1 sick Citizen of its type.

Night-phase text: L05A, L06A, L06B, D008-D011, D037. *(closure: D008/D009 print "At the end of the Night Phase": marked atEnd in dusk_1.json so they run after the standing-sickness step; D010/D011/D037 print no end timing and stay in the normal run. Tests in audit8_group_cards_dusk.test.ts.)*
Hope 6 spaces, Discontent 5 spaces (+ the 6th placement loses). Tokens slide left; exhausted/active sides.

Untyped increase Hope/decrease Discontent: choose to draw a random token from the bag and place it exhausted at the leftmost empty space, or activate an exhausted token. (Digital: automatic choice-free rule — draw if the track has room and the bag isn't empty, else activate; the player can choose when both are possible — Ask).
Typed increase (`hope+1:care`): draw a random token (any type), place it exhausted, then activate one exhausted token of the indicated type if possible.

Decrease Hope: exhaust an active token, or (if none active, or the effect says remove) remove an exhausted token to the bag and slide left. Last Hope removed ⇒ LOSE. "Must remove if no active token exists."
Activate / exhaust effects are ignored if impossible, unless exhausting is a cost.
Discontent increase: same rules for the Discontent track; a 6th Discontent placed ⇒ LOSE. Discontent decrease = exhaust an active token or discard an exhausted one.

"Spend" requires the full amount; "lose" takes what is available. *(closure: done. fx/core.ts (feasible, payable, ifPay, doSpendOr); fx/tokens_supply.ts (payable, spendTok); fx/tokens_people.ts 'lose' asks via supplyDist/askDistribute; 5 audit7 HOP-07 tests.)*

L15 Public Council: you choose the token when drawing. L20 Virtue effects. *(closure: done. hope.ts askChosenDraw (L15); audit_9_orphans.test.ts (L15); L20 virtue behaviour in audit5_virtue_virtue.test.ts.)*
Sickness marker per type 0-50 with Syringe/Skull side; Citizen marker per type 0-50.
Gain sick (+1): marker +1; if that would exceed the Citizen marker, flip instead (Syringe→Skull = gravely ill, no effect; already Skull ⇒ nothing).
Flip Skull→Syringe: one Citizen of that type dies and the Sickness marker moves back 1.
If the Citizen marker drops below the Sickness marker, move the Sickness marker back.

Unspecified type = player's choice (Ask); "current" = type of the current Round column. *(closure: done. D000 gainSickPerCorpse maps to sickAny (fx/tokens_people.ts): the player picks the type for each corpse; audit7 SIC-05 test.)*
Cure N: move Sickness markers back (any type split) 1 per point; unused points lost. A Skull marker cannot be cured to 0 until Treated.
Treat N: flip Skull→Syringe without death per point.
Death: Corpse marker +1 (reaching the last Corpse space ⇒ LOSE), Citizen marker −1.

Three stacks (A cards). Beacon needed to deploy; 1 active (2 with upgraded Beacon).
Scouts advance in the Weather phase by the card's value (T01 +1 on Deploy/Continue) up the stack's circular spaces; at the top the group must Skip (A/B cards only) or Explore.
Skip: draw a card from the next deck (A→B, B→C), overlay it, Scout goes to its first space; leftover movement continues on the new card.

Explore: card flips black; choose an option: Continue (take a B/C card, put the Scout on its first space, remaining movement lost, effects deferred) or Return (Scout back to supply, resolve the chosen option plus all deferred Continue effects of black cards in the stack).
Return `next`: "New A" ⇒ remove the stack, start a new A stack; "B"/"C" ⇒ flip all cards back white, overlay a new card of that letter.
